description: M_ECO_Route_grand_gabarit is a dataset listed in Tournai open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Tournai. Coverage: Tournai. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-tournai-portal.
